metrics.stall_scope: Deadlock count covers unscheduled walking/yielding stalls only. Signal queues, scheduled dwell and staff work are measured separately; zero deadlocks does not mean zero long pauses.
metrics.validation_scope: All frames and continuous linear pair motion between cached samples; authored ground obstacles
metrics.central_region: abs(x)<12.76 and abs(z)<12.76 metres; excludes outer arterial arms
